description: UI updates to bookings/show.blade.php: 5-minute access window copy, live session-in-progress panel with teaching timer, session-ending banner, partial/no_show status panels, tutor feedback form, and countdown to room-open time. Depends on FEAT-001 (new model helpers) but independent of FEAT-002/003.
steps: Modify `resources/views/pages/bookings/show.blade.php`. Change the 'Session Room Waiting' panel copy: replace all occurrences of '60 minutes' with '5 minutes'. The current text says 'This room opens 60 minutes before your session starts' — change to '5 minutes before'. The $minutesUntil PHP variable already computes `now()->diffInMinutes($sessionStart, false)` (negative = past). Change the panel's 'Opens in X min' display to be based on `($booking->scheduled_at->copy()->subMinutes(5)->diffInMinutes(now(), false))` — add a new PHP variable `$minutesUntilOpen = now()->diffInMinutes($booking->scheduled_at->copy()->subMinutes(5), false)` in the @php block.

In the same file, update the JS countdown target. The existing countdown targets `$sessionStart` (the PHP Carbon object). Change the JS `const targetTime = {{ $sessionStart->timestamp * 1000 }};` to `const targetTime = {{ $booking->scheduled_at->copy()->subMinutes(5)->timestamp * 1000 }};` so the countdown shows time until the room opens (5 min before start), not time until the session itself.

Add a 'Session In Progress' panel to `resources/views/pages/bookings/show.blade.php`. This panel is shown when `$booking->actual_start_at && !$booking->actual_end_at && $booking->status === 'confirmed'`. It contains: (a) a teaching timer that counts up from `actual_start_at` using JS `setInterval` — `const startMs = {{ $booking->actual_start_at?->timestamp * 1000 ?? 0 }};`; (b) a remaining time display that counts down from `scheduledEndAt()` — `const endMs = {{ $booking->scheduledEndAt()->timestamp * 1000 }}; const durationMs = {{ $booking->duration_minutes * 60 * 1000 }};`. Style the panel with the same inline-CSS approach as the rest of the file (background #fff, border-radius:22px, etc.).

Add a 'Session Ending Soon' banner to `resources/views/pages/bookings/show.blade.php`. Show this when the session is in the last 5 minutes of its booked duration OR in the 30-minute closing buffer. PHP condition for server-side rendering: `$inClosingBuffer = now()->between($booking->scheduledEndAt()->subMinutes(5), $booking->scheduledEndAt()->addMinutes(30))`. Display a yellow banner with text 'Session ending soon — please wrap up.' and a note about the 5-minute closing buffer.

Add status panels for 'partial' and 'no_show' to `resources/views/pages/bookings/show.blade.php`. After the existing `@elseif($booking->status === 'cancelled')` block add: `@elseif($booking->status === 'partial')` yellow panel 'Session Partially Delivered' with delivery_status details and refund info; `@elseif($booking->status === 'no_show')` red panel 'Tutor No-Show' with refund info. Both panels should show a link to the booking's refund status if `$booking->refund` exists.

Add tutor feedback form to `resources/views/pages/bookings/show.blade.php`. After the student review `@if($booking->status === 'completed' && $isStudent && !$booking->review)` block, add: `@if(($booking->status === 'completed' || $booking->status === 'partial') && $isTutor && !$booking->tutor_feedback)` — an Alpine.js form (matching the student review form style) with a 1-5 star rating (`tutor_rating`) and a textarea (`tutor_feedback`), POSTing to `/bookings/{{ $booking->uuid }}/tutor-feedback`.

Add `POST /bookings/{booking:uuid}/tutor-feedback` route to `routes/web.php` inside the auth group. Inline route closure (same pattern as the existing review route): validate `tutor_feedback` (required, string, max:1000) and `tutor_rating` (required, integer, min:1, max:5), verify `auth()->id() === $booking->tutor_id`, update booking with these fields, return `response()->json(['status'=>'ok'])`.
acceptance_criteria: Visiting /bookings/{uuid} for a confirmed upcoming booking shows '5 minutes before' (not '60 minutes') in the waiting panel
The JS countdown in bookings/show counts down to scheduled_at minus 5 minutes
The 'Session In Progress' panel is rendered (server-side) when actual_start_at is set and actual_end_at is null
The 'Session Ending Soon' banner appears in the closing buffer window
A booking with status='partial' shows the 'Partially Delivered' yellow panel without PHP/Blade errors
A booking with status='no_show' shows the 'Tutor No-Show' red panel without PHP/Blade errors
The tutor feedback form is visible for completed bookings when viewed as tutor
POST to /bookings/{uuid}/tutor-feedback saves tutor_feedback and tutor_rating to the bookings table
php artisan route:list shows the tutor-feedback route
verification: Load /bookings/{uuid} in browser for bookings with various statuses (confirmed, completed, partial, no_show) and confirm no Blade errors
